setup.heading: Set up your profile
setup.intro: Only your username is required. You can change both names later in Settings.
setup.penNameNotSaved: Your username is saved, but not the pen name. You can add it in Settings.

handle.label: Username
handle.hint: 3 to 30 characters. Any characters work, but we block swearwords, names that look like our staff’s and look-alike letters that copy another name. People use it to find and mention you.
handle.checkFailed: We couldn’t check this name just now. We’ll check again when you save.

outcomes.invisible_characters: Remove the invisible characters. They’re used to fake names.
outcomes.spaces: A username can’t have spaces. Try a dot or an underscore instead.
outcomes.looks_like_staff: This username looks like a staff name. Try another one.
outcomes.reserved: One of our pages uses this name. Try another one.
outcomes.not_allowed: This username isn’t allowed. Try another one.
outcomes.taken: Someone already has this username, or one that looks the same.
outcomes.too_soon: You can change your username once every {{days}} days.

penName.label: Pen name (optional)
penName.hint: Shown on your stories instead of your username. You can change it once every {{days}} days. We never ask for your real name.

outcomes.invisible_characters: Remove the invisible characters. They’re used to fake names.
outcomes.looks_like_staff: This pen name looks like a staff name. Try another one.
outcomes.not_allowed: This pen name isn’t allowed. Try another one.
outcomes.too_soon: You can change your pen name once every {{days}} days.

falseHit.text: Think we got this wrong, for example because it’s your surname?
falseHit.link: Ask a moderator to check it

settings.heading: Settings
settings.usernameHint: People find you by this. You can change it once every {{days}} days.
settings.penNameHint: Shown on your stories instead of your username. Leave it empty to show your username. You can change it once every {{days}} days.
settings.nextChange: You can change it again on {{date}}.
settings.legalText: The terms of use, the privacy notice and the community guidelines, with every earlier version.
settings.signedOut: Log in to see your settings.

notice.heading: Choose a username
notice.body: You need a username before you can publish, comment or post. It only takes a moment.

errors.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your account. Check your connection and try again.
errors.saveFailed: We couldn’t save that. Check your connection and try again.

devices.heading: Signed-in devices
devices.body: Where you’re logged in right now. If you don’t recognise a device, log it out and change your password.
devices.signOutOthers: Log out of all other devices
devices.signedOutOthers: Your other devices are logged out.
devices.privacy: We show the browser and the kind of device only. We don’t keep your IP address or where you are.
devices.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your devices. Check your connection and try again.
devices.actionFailed: That didn’t work. Check your connection and try again.
devices.lagNote: A device you log out can’t renew its access; it may stay open for up to an hour.

country.label: Country
country.note: We take it from your connection when you join, and never ask. Think it’s wrong?

suspension.title: Your account is suspended until {{until}}.
suspension.body: You can read and download your data, but you can’t publish, comment or message until then.

reporting_pause.title: Your reporting is paused until {{until}}.
reporting_pause.body: Reports you sent were found unfounded again and again, so reporting is paused for a while. You can still read and write.

email.heading: Email address
email.private: Only you can see it. It’s never on your profile or shown to other people.
email.pending: Waiting to change to {{email}}. Type the two codes we sent to finish.
email.newHint: We’ll send a 6-digit code to your current address and another to the new one. The change happens once you type both.
email.sent: Check both inboxes: we sent a code to {{email}} and another to your current address. Until you type both, your current address keeps working.
email.invalidAddress: That doesn’t look like an email address. Check it and try again.
email.addressInUse: Another account already uses this address.
email.tooManyAttempts: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
email.changeFailed: We couldn’t send the codes. Check your connection and try again.
email.wrongCode: This code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or send new codes.
email.codesCheckFailed: We couldn’t check the codes. Check your connection and try again.
email.changed: Done. Your email address is now {{email}}.

birthday.heading: Birthday
birthday.intro: Add your birthday if you’d like a greeting: we say happy birthday month all month and happy birthday on the day. The month is enough; the day is up to you.
birthday.private: Only you can see it, and it never has a year. Your year of birth from sign-up stays as it is and can’t be changed.
birthday.saveFailed: We couldn’t save your birthday. Check your connection and try again.

ageCheck.heading: Confirm your age
ageCheck.intro13: We check that you’re 13 or over, and whether you’re under 18, so you get the right safety settings.
ageCheck.intro18: We check that you’re 18 or over, so you get the settings for adults.
ageCheck.methodsIntro: You choose one on Yoti’s page.
ageCheck.selfieBody: Yoti estimates your age from a photo, then deletes it.
ageCheck.documentBody: Use your ID card or passport. Use this if you’d rather not take a selfie, or if the selfie check didn’t work.
ageCheck.startHint: Takes you to Yoti’s page. When you’re done, you come back here.
ageCheck.keptBody: the result (for example “13 or over”), the date and which method you used. Never your photo or your document.
ageCheck.step2: You take a selfie or scan your ID there.
ageCheck.step3: You come back here and see your result.
ageCheck.readOnly: Until the check is done, you can read but not post.
ageCheck.signedOut: Log in to check your age.
ageCheck.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your age check. Try again in a moment.
ageCheck.nothingToDo: There’s no age check to do right now.
ageCheck.birthYearInSettings: Your year of birth is in Settings.
ageCheck.photoDeleted: Yoti deleted your photo after the check.

errors.signed_out: Your session ended. Log in again to check your age.
errors.not_needed: There’s no age check to do right now.
errors.unavailable: The age check isn’t available right now. Try again later.
errors.unreachable: We couldn’t reach the age check. Check your connection and try again.

return.checkingBody: We’re waiting for the result from Yoti. This can take a moment. Keep this page open.
return.adultYearBody: Settings for adults need an “18 or over” result. You can get one with an ID document.
return.failedBody: The check didn’t give a clear result. You can try again, or use an ID document instead.
return.notFinishedBody: The Yoti page was closed or ran out of time. Nothing from it was kept. Start a new check when you’re ready.
return.cancelledBody: You left Yoti’s page before the check finished. Nothing from it was kept. Start a new check when you’re ready.

notice.heading: Confirm your age
notice.body: Until your age is confirmed, you can read but not post.

ageCheck.fourteenDays: If it isn’t done within 14 days of joining, we delete the account and your year (and month) of birth.

manual.askLine: Ask for a manual check. A person checks it and replies within 5 working days. They never see a photo.
manual.askFailed: We couldn’t send your request. Try again in a moment.
manual.openTitle: A person is checking your age.
manual.openBody: They reply within 5 working days. Your account stays read-only until then.
manual.refusedTitle: We couldn’t confirm your age by hand.
manual.refusedBody: The reason: {{reason}} You can start a new check with Yoti.

parentConsent.heading: Ask a parent or guardian
parentConsent.intro: You’re under 16, so a parent or guardian needs to agree. We’ll email them a link.
parentConsent.sentHeading: We emailed your parent or guardian
parentConsent.sentBody: We sent a link to {{email}}. They need to open it and say yes.
parentConsent.opensAfter: Publishing, comments, forum posts and messages open after they say yes.
parentConsent.deadline: If nobody says yes by {{date}}, we delete your account and its data.
parentConsent.agreedBody: Your parent or guardian agreed on {{date}}. You can now publish, comment, post and send messages.
parentConsent.withdrawnHeading: Your parent or guardian withdrew their consent
parentConsent.withdrawnBody: Your account is read-only for now: you can read, but not publish, comment, post or send messages. We’ll tell you and them what happens next.
parentConsent.nothingToDo: There’s nothing to ask a parent or guardian for right now.
parentConsent.signedOut: Log in to ask a parent or guardian.
parentConsent.loadFailed: We couldn’t load this page. Try again in a moment.

failures.signed_out: Log in again, then send the email.
failures.own_email: That’s your own email. Use your parent’s or guardian’s.
failures.too_soon: Wait a minute before sending again.
failures.not_needed: There’s nothing to ask a parent or guardian for right now.
failures.unavailable: We couldn’t send the email. Try again in a moment.

notice.heading: Ask a parent or guardian
notice.body: You’re under 16, so a parent or guardian needs to agree before you can publish, comment, post or send messages.

parent.heading: Your child wants to join {{productName}}
parent.intro: Someone signed up with {{email}} as @{{handle}} and gave your email as their parent or guardian. They told us they were born in {{year}}, and they passed an age check. Their account stays limited until you answer.
parent.whatBody: A free place to write and read stories, poems and essays. Writers keep the rights to their work.
parent.keepBody: Their email, their username, a pen name if they choose one, their year of birth (and birth month, if we needed it) and the age check result. We never ask for their real name.
parent.protectMessages: Adults can never message anyone under 16. If they’re 16 or 17, messages from adults are off unless they turn them on.
parent.protectReports: They can block and report anyone. A person reads every report.
parent.protectRatings: Stories are rated All ages, 13+, 16+ or 18+. Your child only sees stories rated for their age.
parent.protectAds: Ads match the page and are the same for everyone. They never use your child’s profile.
parent.legalIntro: Read these before you answer. Both are in Romanian and English.
parent.guardian: I’m this child’s parent or legal guardian.
parent.guardianNeeded: Tick that you’re the parent or legal guardian first.
parent.deadline: If you don’t answer by {{date}}, we delete the account and its data.
parent.agreedBody: @{{handle}} can now publish, comment, post and send messages. We emailed you a confirmation. You can withdraw your consent here at any time.
parent.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw your consent? The account becomes read-only straight away.
parent.refusedBody: We won’t activate this account, and we’ve deleted it and its data.
parent.withdrawnBody: @{{handle}}’s account is read-only. If you have questions about what happens next, write to us.
parent.goneBody: A newer email may have replaced it, or the account was deleted. If you think this is wrong, write to us.
